description: Published DCS request attributes and identity pairs. Every generic DCS field is optional; d_rtbd=json requests a JSON response. A click call with d_event=click must include d_rd. Visitor ID-specific version and organization requirements are handled by the ECID pack.

params.name: d_mid
params.description: It is an existing ECID. Adobe's reuse call sends d_mid with d_ver=2.
params.fix_hint: Send d_mid when you already have an Experience Cloud ID for the visitor.

params.name: d_cid
params.description: Provider ID or integration code with user ID separated by %01. Single pairs may include 0/1/2 authentication state. The impression guide uses 20914 for an Android GAID and 20915 for an iOS IDFA. The generic DCS table permits multiple provider/user pairs in one parameter; the CID guide also permits repeated keys.

params.name: d_cb
params.description: The vendor documents `d_cb` in the request contract.

params.name: d_cid_ic
params.description: Provider ID or integration code with user ID separated by %01. Single pairs may include0/1/2authentication state. The generic DCS table permits multiple provider/user pairs in one parameter; the CID guide also permits repeated keys.

params.name: d_caller
params.description: Caller identification; no published character grammar.

params.name: d_coppa
params.description: Disables third-party-cookie use. Published table specifies behavior without a complete literal-value enum.

params.name: d_cts
params.description: Optional account-enabled traits/segments return mode:1legacy segment IDs or2current IDs.

params.name: d_dpid
params.description: Deprecated data provider ID, still supported in ID and event calls.

params.name: d_dpuuid
params.description: Deprecated provider-specific user ID, still supported in ID and event calls.

params.name: d_dst
params.description: Include URL destination data in a JSON response.

params.name: d_dst_filter
params.description: Reserved Analytics/Audience Manager integration attribute with unpublished value grammar.

params.name: d_jsonv
params.description: Response JSON version1;0disables ID syncs.

params.name: d_nsid
params.description: JavaScript container namespace used by DIL for ID synchronization; account namespace registration is external.

params.name: d_ptfm
params.description: Published platform literal registry.

params.name: d_rs
params.description: Deprecated reserved Analytics/Audience Manager attribute, without a published value grammar.

params.name: d_rtbd
params.description: JSON response selector. Required when a JSON response is requested; absence returns a pixel.

params.name: d_sid
params.description: Trait/segment score ID; membership is account configuration.

params.name: d_tdpid
params.description: Data source for trait evaluation. Public examples use/event, and the linked generic DCS table does not exclude/id.

params.name: d_tdpid_ic
params.description: Integration-code form of trait-evaluation data source. Source uses/event examples without declaring/id exclusion.

params.name: d_uuid
params.description: Audience Manager visitor UUID when absent from cookie; numeric-only grammar is not published in this table.

params.name: h_host
params.description: Client collection hostname represented as DCS HTTP-header attribute, without a complete serialized query grammar.

params.name: h_user-agent
params.description: User-Agent header value represented as DCS HTTP-header attribute, without a complete serialized query grammar.

params.name: h_accept-language
params.description: Accept-Language header value represented as DCS HTTP-header attribute, without a complete serialized query grammar.

params.name: h_referer
params.description: Referer header value represented as DCS HTTP-header attribute, without a complete serialized query grammar.

params.name: h_referrer
params.description: Referrer header value represented as DCS HTTP-header attribute, without a complete serialized query grammar.

params.name: h_date
params.description: Date header value represented as DCS HTTP-header attribute, without a complete serialized query grammar.

params.name: c_*
params.description: Public customer-defined DCS attribute. The key prefix is published; the value schema is configured by the customer.

params.name: p_*
params.description: Private customer-defined DCS attribute, used for trait evaluation and not logged. The key prefix is published; the value schema is configured by the customer.

params.name: d_event
params.description: Click tracking calls use d_event=click. Impression calls use d_event=imp. Other event names are not published, so only a nonempty value is checked.
params.fix_hint: Set d_event=click on a click tracking call, or omit d_event when this is not a click.

params.name: d_rd
params.description: Click tracking calls require d_rd as the redirect URL and say to encode it twice. After one query decode a correct value is still percent-encoded, so this check only requires a nonempty value.
params.fix_hint: Set d_rd to the redirect URL, encoded twice.

params.name: d_creative
params.description: The click macro table says d_creative is the numeric creative ID from the ad server. No digit length is published.
params.fix_hint: Set d_creative to the numeric creative ID, or omit it.

params.name: d_adgroup
params.description: The click macro table says d_adgroup is the numeric ad group ID from the ad server and marks it optional. No digit length is published.
params.fix_hint: Set d_adgroup to the numeric ad group ID, or omit it.

params.name: d_bu
params.description: The click macro table says d_bu is the numeric business unit ID. It is required for Audience Optimization reports, not for every click call. No digit length is published.
params.fix_hint: Set d_bu to the numeric business unit ID, or omit it.

params.name: d_campaign
params.description: The click macro table says d_campaign is the numeric campaign ID from the ad server. It is required for Audience Optimization reports, not for every click call. No digit length is published.
params.fix_hint: Set d_campaign to the numeric campaign ID, or omit it.

params.name: d_placement
params.description: The click macro table says d_placement is the numeric placement ID from the ad server. No digit length is published.
params.fix_hint: Set d_placement to the numeric placement ID, or omit it.

params.name: d_site
params.description: The click macro table says d_site is the numeric site ID from the ad server and marks it optional. No digit length is published.
params.fix_hint: Set d_site to the numeric site ID, or omit it.

params.name: d_src
params.description: The impression guide says d_src is the data source ID or integration code of the platform providing the metadata. The click example is numeric. No character grammar is published, so only a nonempty value is checked.
params.fix_hint: Set d_src to the data source ID or integration code, or omit it.

params.name: d_adsrc
params.description: The impression guide says d_adsrc is the advertiser data source ID or integration code. It is required for Audience Optimization reports and optional on the call. No character grammar is published.
params.fix_hint: Set d_adsrc to the advertiser data source ID or integration code, or omit it.

params.name: d_bust
params.description: The impression guide says d_bust is an optional cache-busting value, followed by a random string. It does not require digits.
params.fix_hint: Set d_bust to a random string, or omit it.

params.name: r_rand
params.description: The click macro table says r_rand is a random number used for cache busting. No digit length is published.
params.fix_hint: Set r_rand to a random whole number, or omit it.

rules.message: A click tracking call must include d_rd, the redirect URL.
rules.fix_hint: Add d_rd set to the redirect URL, encoded twice.
